player_visible_gap: MilitarySoldier.clearLine selected only pickable LivingEntity bodies. It missed nonliving aircraft and multipart receiving proxies (e.g. Hydra has a nonpickable parent). FirearmsCombat already stopped those actual bullets, so an ally in the lane could consume repeated soldier magazines without damage instead of canceling/repositioning the burst.

source.authored_gate: Rifle/saw/sniper shoot bank315096 has TargetHasLoFDistance315236. Standing Node315312 requires TargetHasLoF315356; lower crouch Node316000 requires TargetHasLoF316044; raised alternate316480 has its own LoF. LoF is part of action admission, not only a receiving damage filter.
source.mask_boundary: Standing/raised CollideWithType49219=0xC043, crouched51267=0xC843. Prior P1 enum evidence resolves bit1 as SimulatedObject and bit6 as Prop. Exact native aircraft/actor classification and all TimeTolerance/DistanceTolerance caching rules are NOT claimed closed by this patch.
source.space_boundary: No source distance, posture or world-unit conversion is changed in this batch.

implementation: MilitarySoldier.clearLine now calls the existing FirearmsCombat.bulletCandidate predicate through the same ProjectileUtil path used by real bullets.

Existing HydraProjectileContactMixin clips Hydra/Flyer/Greene proxies to actual posed skin and restores exact closest contact. This patch does not expand proxy AABBs into solid hit volumes or duplicate the geometry solver.

The closest ordinary/aircraft/part hit is compared to VehicleDamageBridge.nearest real ground-hull contact with the ordinary bullet path's .001 ordering tolerance. A farther protected hull cannot preempt a nearer legal receiver.

An aircraft first hit uses protectedAircraft, including live crew/protected passenger policy. Part hits resolve to the living parent before validTarget, preserving scoreboard friendship, disguised/creative/spectator player rejection and the target's own legal parts.
Empty protected aircraft blocks rather than spending a round. A legitimate hostile crew hull or living receiver may still receive the shot under existing firearm policy.
Actual goal interruption/repositioning, fresh aim interval, finite ammo and final fire recheck are unchanged; they now receive the missing line obstruction.

The same Soldier campaign-core entry used a second LivingEntity-only filter. It now uses the identical ordinary-bullet candidate predicate and continues rejecting any actor between muzzle and the authorized block.
adaptation_limits: Fresh MC block/physical receiver checks remain stricter than native LoF cache tolerances; no firing through stale clearance.
Aircraft contact remains the current actual bullet AABB, not a newly claimed native helicopter skin hull.
MC explicit allegiance/protected-crew rules are retained. Source collision mask membership alone is not treated as native friendship proof.
No changes to shared mixins, registrations, network, firearms damage, vehicle control or other creature production.

Removing friendship and targeting Hydra then permits finite actual bullets/damage to its own parent-resolved parts.

fixture_limits: Stationary marks use movement speed0 without bypassing live goal, gun, permission or ammo. Multipart contact-only fixture uses noGravity marks around a real constant idle root/base lane; it is not a claim of natural floating soldiers. Default target acquisition was separately covered by MilitaryRifleRangeGameTest.
